# Clay and Bricks Pvt Ltd

> Odisha's premier turnkey architectural design, luxury interior design, and civil construction studio in Bhubaneswar. Single-point accountability, 3D digital twins, factory-grade precision millwork, and 10-year structural warranty.

## Core Identity & Studio Overview
Clay and Bricks Pvt Ltd is an integrated architecture and construction firm headquartered in Bhubaneswar, Odisha. The studio bridges the traditional divide between visionary interior architecture and rigorous civil execution. Rather than managing separate architects, contractors, and carpenters, clients engage Clay and Bricks for complete, single-point turnkey delivery from raw groundbreak to final furnish.

- **Headquarters**: Plot No. 400/3226/6837, Lane 1, Mahadev Nagar, Jharpada, Bhubaneswar, Odisha — 751006, India
- **Phone**: +91 88673 55661
- **Email**: hi.clayandbricks@gmail.com
- **Website**: https://clayandbricks.com
- **Hours**: Monday – Saturday, 10:00 AM – 7:30 PM IST (Consultations by Appointment)

## Primary Disciplines & Capabilities
1. **Turnkey Interior Architecture**: Full-scope spatial planning, bespoke modular millwork, acoustic ceiling grids, custom brass joinery, Italian marble installation, and luxury furniture procurement.
2. **Structural Civil Construction**: Deep foundation piling, seismic-resistant RCC frame casting, high-grade waterproofing, and turnkey villa contracting under licensed civil engineers.
3. **Photorealistic 3D Digital Twins**: Millimeter-accurate raytraced 3D visual models reflecting solar angles, real lighting temperatures, and exact material reflections before construction begins.
4. **Architectural Elevation & Planning**: Contemporary villa elevation, climate-adaptive vernacular facades (using Khandolite stone and local laterite), and BDA (Bhubaneswar Development Authority) compliant architectural drafting.
5. **Quality Assurance & Warranty**: 400-point quality verification protocol, milestone digital telemetry updates, and an industry-leading 10-Year Structural Integrity Warranty.

## Geographic Service Zones (Local Coverage)
- **Primary Market**: Bhubaneswar, Odisha
  - Prime Residential Hubs: Shree Vihar, Patia, Saheed Nagar, Jayadev Vihar, Nayapalli, Khandagiri, Chandrasekharpur, Jharpada, Rasulgarh, Infocity, KIIT Square.
- **Extended Markets**: Cuttack (CDA Sectors, Cantonment), Puri (Coastal Villas), and Khordha district.

## Representative Portfolio Projects
- **Luxury Villa, Shree Vihar, Bhubaneswar**: 9,500 sq ft, 8-bedroom multi-generational estate featuring modular sage cabinetry, fluted glass partitions, Italian marble, and private rooftop lounge.
- **3 BHK Apartment, Laxmi Imperial, Bhubaneswar**: 2,150 sq ft luxury modern residence with warm wood fluted walls, custom vitrines, and understated ambient lighting.
- **Bibhu Babu Villa, Bhubaneswar**: 6,800 sq ft contemporary duplex villa uniting RCC engineering and bespoke interior finishing.
- **Laterite Villa, Bhubaneswar**: 4,200 sq ft climate-responsive home celebrating indigenous Odisha laterite masonry and modern minimalism.
- **Brass & Noir Kitchen, Bhubaneswar**: High-end culinary suite with brass accents, matte black cabinetry, and quartz surfaces.
- **Terracotta Sanctuary, Bhubaneswar**: Earthy, organic residential master suite combining terracotta textures, teakwood, and soft indirect cove illumination.
- **Stone Office, Janpath, Bhubaneswar**: 3,600 sq ft boutique corporate headquarters featuring acoustic timber slats and acoustic privacy zones.
- **Forest Pool Villa, Cuttack/Bhubaneswar outskirts**: 7,200 sq ft tropical modern estate centered around a reflective pool and indoor courtyards.
- **Konark Boutique Hotel, Puri/Bhubaneswar corridor**: 18-suite luxury hospitality architecture honoring the Sun Temple's solar geometry and stone craft.
